units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 98a:14">Snh. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>סוסיא ב׳</he> a white horse, v. <cite ref="B00045"><he>בָּארַג</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>בַּרְקֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 8:4:4">Y. B. Bath. VIII, 16ᵇ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:5:8">Y. Kidd. I, 60ᶜ</cite> bot. he let him ride <he>אתרי ריכשי ב׳</he> on two white steeds (i.e. the donator gave him a doubly fortified document; another opin.: he made him ride on two …, which run in different directions, i.e. the document is invalid; v. explan. ibid., cmp.
<cite ref="Gittin 69a:2">Gitt. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>שודרא ב׳</he> a string of white hair.
<cite ref="Shabbat 67a:1">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b:5">Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>נירא ב׳</he> a white thread (of hair).

senses.gloss: (as a noun) something white, white thread. Ib. וליתוב ב׳ וכ׳ and let him put a white thread around one end. Ib. פתילי ב׳ Ms. M. (ed. פתילתא ביקרא, corr. acc.) strings of white stuff.
